safety.confidence_note: Full texts read (PMC5947135, PMC6175232). The Phase IIb's ~150 active patients could have shown a <1% serious-reaction tail and did not (no grade III/IV, no epinephrine); scored partial rather than contra because the harm category and its rate were predicted.

safety.judgement: Safety split by modality (injected peptide hydrolysate). Model side (Phase IIb full text): 'There were no reports of SRs grade III or IV, anaphylactic reactions requiring the use of epinephrine or fatalities' and 'In 89.9% of the patients, no SR occurred at all.' The predicted harm (early systemic reactions, ~10%, mild) appeared at the same rate; three serious ESRs in asthmatics were not predicted. A checker may prefer contra on the severity miss; the call here follows the predicted category and rate.
